method: derived from block_updates/surfaces.json: for each attached block and support side, the holder rule (present: any block but air; collision: any collision box; face_full: collision covers the face toward the attached block; face_centre: collision covers the middle 2/16 square of that face) with the fewest exceptions, then the holders that always or never hold it against the rule (every measured state agreeing) and single holder states that differ; gravity blocks as holders are left out (they vary with their own fall)
